title: How far must an infinite lift travel to go up past zero?
description: An infinite lift has no building around it and goes on forever above and below level zero. The lift starts below zero and must reach a level high above it, so the climb is split into two parts at zero. Keeko's doubt is that taking away always makes a number smaller.
teaching_notes: One idea: taking away a negative number adds, because the lift first climbs to zero and then climbs on. Watch for students who think subtraction always gives a smaller number and take the negative number away as a positive one.

source: Carry out the subtraction +2000 − (−200). Imagine a lift wit
video_script.why: The child carries out a subtraction of a negative number on an infinite lift and sees that it equals an addition.
video_script.substitution: The book's own infinite lift: starting level negative two hundred and target level positive two thousand.
video_script.anchor: the infinite lift with levels going up and down without end from level zero
video_script.wrong_answer: the answer is one thousand eight hundred
video_script.wrong_move: believes taking away must make a number smaller, and takes positive two hundred from two thousand
video_script.payoff_line: The button press is positive two thousand two hundred.

names.{{NAME_10}}: the building with floors above and below the ground

maths_rules: movement needed = target level - starting level = (+2000) - (-200)
from -200 up to 0 is +200; from 0 up to +2000 is +2000
video_script.design: One tall lift shaft with level zero marked, a short climb below zero and a long climb above it.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; an infinite lift shaft with level 0 in the middle, going on up and down; the lift at level -200 and the target level +2000

marks.scene: the title card arrives and the infinite lift is drawn
marks.ends: arrows show the shaft going on without end, up and down
marks.ask: the lift stops at level -200 and level +2000 lights up far above

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about an infinite lift.
<bookmark mark='ends'/>It has no walls around it and goes on forever, up and down, from level zero.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The lift is at level negative two hundred and must reach level two thousand. Which button should be pressed?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the shaft with level 0 marked; Target level - Starting level = Movement needed

marks.zero: level zero is marked in the middle of the shaft
marks.rule: the line Target level - Starting level = Movement needed is written

narration: <bookmark mark='zero'/>Level zero is the ground, and the levels go on above it and below it.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>As in the lift of {{NAME_10}}, the movement needed is the target level take away the starting level.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the starting level is negative two hundred, and the target level is positive two thousand.

beats.on_screen: To find: the button press (movement needed)

marks.find: the words button press are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the button press, which is the movement needed.

marks.rule: the rule is written with the two levels put in

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step one, write target level take away starting level.
That is positive two thousand take away negative two hundred.

beats.on_screen: first part: from -200 up to 0 is +200

marks.first: an arrow rises from level -200 to level 0 and +200 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>Step two, the first part of the climb is from negative two hundred up to zero.
That part is two hundred floors up.

beats.on_screen: second part: from 0 up to +2000 is +2000

marks.second: an arrow rises from level 0 to level +2000 and +2000 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='second'/>Step three, the second part of the climb is from zero up to positive two thousand.
That part is two thousand levels up.

marks.add: the two climbs join and 200 + 2000 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='add'/>Step four, add the two parts, two hundred and two thousand.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The button press is positive two thousand two hundred.
<bookmark mark='same'/>Positive two thousand plus positive two hundred gives the same.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Check it, negative two hundred plus positive two thousand two hundred lands on positive two thousand.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: 1800 crossed out; the lift pressed 1800 from level -200 stops at level 1600, short of 2000

marks.short: the lift pressed 1800 from level -200 stops at level 1600
marks.fix: 1800 is struck out and the gap up to level 2000 lights up

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the answer is one thousand eight hundred, because taking away makes a number smaller.
<bookmark mark='short'/>Press that from level negative two hundred, and the lift stops at level sixteen hundred.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>That is short of level two thousand, because the lift starts below zero. Taking away a negative number adds.
